thread_title: Please do not take the current situation too lightly.

content:
My suggestions for the sake of the future:
1. It doesn’t matter if it is only for super whales but AA carries with proper supports should have viable damage to clear madness. The numbers should be adjusted to match. This will make people want to spend.
2. There’s no reason to limit the dtide to 4 difficulties. With the new adjustments there is now a big gap from hard to nightmare difficulty.

I'm a 2-month player who spent a small amount before the d-tide update (got enough silver to activate premium archive rewards) and have just finished Arc 2 Chapter 3 Normal and Arc 1 Chapter 7 Hard with full achievements/silver.

For a new person like me there are lots of charming characters and a lot of story, but also so many adjustments and multiple wildly different gameplay rules to adjust to. I got good at Legacy mode, now need to learn Astral mode with no in-game hand-holding. I got good at classic Realms, now Divine realms function very differently (especially Caro and Ultra compared to the original style).

I just got into high ranks (like the top 1600) on P-Dive and only completed D-tide once, just before this update, not getting a high score but just trying to learn how it all works as a new person. 

I think the devs (or publishers, whoever is pressuring all these rapid changes) have underestimated how many hurdles they are creating with so many radical gameplay changes for players, especially new folks who were willing to spend and learn a lot of these changing rules already. JP server realm experimentation already feels like a mistake. It doubles the work for devs (for now, while 2 different rulesets are active at once) and requires a heavy hand to lead your players to new characters when they often prefer the old style. Now even more heavy-handedness with game modes that were praised before.

Of note, existing player guides for newbies (and there's only really 2 of these due to a small community) only coach people through the old D-tide. As a new player who studied that and just got to try it once: I'm absolutely not learning a new, harder D-tide now. Why would I? For fun? It's not fun. It's not encouraging people to spend, it encourages new people to ignore D-tide entirely.

content:
**Please diversify the characters featured in Battle Pass avatar**


**English**
First, I’d like to mention that my favorite characters are mainly from the Aeqour and Ultra Realms. I buy the premium Battle Pass every season, partly for the “Turn Rewind” feature, but also because I want the premium profile icons.

However, icons always seem to be released in Realm order, starting with Chaos. Even when a new icon series is introduced, Chaos comes first, followed by Caro, while Aeqour and Ultra come later.

Only two or three icons are released each month, so isn’t following Realm and character order far too slow?

I started playing after the first-anniversary event and have now played for over a year and a half. Yet I still haven’t been able to get a premium icon for Sanga, my favorite character.
Frankly, I’m tired of waiting. When will another premium Sanga icon be released? Three years from now, after I’ve already quit? I’m not even sure the game will still be running by then.

Please consider distributing monthly Battle Pass icons more evenly across all Realms, so players who favor Aeqour, Ultra, and other Realms don’t always have to wait until the end.


**中文**
首先说明一下，我主要喜欢 Aeqour 和 Ultra Realm 的角色。每个赛季我都会购买高级战令，一方面是为了“回合回溯”功能，另一方面也是因为想收集高级头像。

但目前头像似乎总是按照 Realm 顺序推出，而且从 Chaos Realm 开始。即使推出新系列，也依然是 Chaos 先出，然后是 Caro，Aeqour 和 Ultra 则排在后面。

一个月本来就只推出两三个头像，还按照 Realm 和角色顺序慢慢排，是不是太慢了？

我是周年庆结束后开始玩的，到现在已经一年半以上了。可我至今都还没有拿到最喜欢的角色 Sanga 的高级头像。
说实话，我已经等累了。Sanga 的其他高级头像到底什么时候才会出？三年以后，等我都退游了吗？甚至不知道游戏到时候还会不会继续运营。

希望今后的月度战令头像能在各个 Realm 之间更均衡地分配，不要总让喜欢 Aeqour、Ultra 和其他 Realm 的玩家排在最后。

Hi, i am Anni,
i am by no means somebody a lot of the community know about, nor am i someone that has invested thousands into this game or someone with significant achievements. So for most of you, you probably do not know who i am. This is to say, this is an impassioned plea from all the people in the community like me. Over the course of the 8 months that i have been actively playing morimens i have fallen in love with it, and have recommended it to just about anyone i have come across. At this point, i do not think i can do that anymore. Here is the dumbed down list of things that the community at large has not like from the dev team in recent times:

- Divine Realms were cool as a 1 off thing for characters like gmurphy, but every new character seems to be having them, making teambuilding kind of stale and the story telling behind them less meaningful. 
- the corposant last verse interaction being "bug fixed" just after they both ran on banner, making the banner retroactively be affected by false advertising, this has been perceived as a really scummy change by the community as a whole
-  The game's only real end game mode D-Tide has effectively been changed in a way that it has become way less fun for effectively anybody and cant really even be cleared on the highest difficulties by players like me, and trust me, i have tried, for 6+ hours i sat in a vc with my 8 month old account trying to beat nightmare a single time
- The response to d-tide feedback were embarrassing. The biggest complaint was that dtide is way less fun in its current state than before, because we cannot actively choose to challenge ourselfs "just a bit more" with going from alert 3 to 4 or 4 to 5. How is that getting fixed by decreasing hard mode difficulty? That just means we get more rewards. That was never really what anybody asked for, and i have read all 8000+ messages in the feedback thread, the same rewards as before was just fine. Morimens was one of the few gachas on the market that actually had good gameplay, dont take this away from us. And there is more even after that.
- scintilla or however the card frames are called are super low effort and on some awakeners, they are barely even noticeable, leading to 1 guy on reddit designing what is essentially a way better version of them within a week of them releasing. 
- Getting them is virtually impossible with how affinity farming got taken away from us as well, i cannot imagine ever getting a character to level 20 before summer next year with the way the games affinity system currently works, and that is with me having an Awakener at 15 to start with.
- There are countless screenshots of devs straight up lying about future changes to the game.
- There is probably more changes that i have forgotten here, but i think this paints enough of a picture.

Morimens was the first gacha game i have ever spent any money on, and back then i did it because i had high hopes for the game and saw a cool community behind it. Currently im beginning to regret it and i dont  know if im the only one, but i cant motivate some of my friends to start up the game with me anymore. And most times, when anything about the game is being discussed i cant help but notice a tinge of sadness and depression in the room. I mean ive even seen whales complain about the current state of the game and community.

All of the above issues remain unadressed by the devs at large. All we want to know is what is going on, so we can stop screaming into the void.

Hello, light.
First of all, thank you for the free pulls.

I will need to test the nerfs next dtide to see if they solve the problems that I had with the difficulty. Someone made a graph of the differences in dtides between last patch and now with the proposed nerfs labeled on the graph, and I am still a bit concerned that further nerfs will be needed, but I am willing to try it out first.

But the hp and damage creep of dtide was only one of a number of issues that were present in the latest update. I am sure that you have heard what they are many times already, but I will summarize the ones I can remember again so they are all in one place:

-bosses with mechanics that are extremely irritating. Ghelot in particular has mechanics that may have been fine on their own (can only play so many cards a turn, no shields for the players on certain turns, invulnerability during certain turns, complete invulnerability during rouse turn) but when you put them all into the same fight makes for an absolutely miserable experience 

-the border that you get for affinity 20 is boring and not worth the ridiculous amount of currency required to get the tokens of concord. Someone in the discord created examples for you that are the exact kind of thing we were expecting and excited for, I think you should look at them. 

-surprise nerfs with no warning or compensation. It’s not just corposant, the dtide power creep by itself decimated a large number of characters. I am now seeing tier lists claiming that glotan and mouchette are both F tier now literally right after they released. This does not inspire me to be excited to pull anything because how long will that character actually be good for?

-certain characters were already powercrept before the changes and in desperate need of a buff, with Kathigu-Ra and doresain being specific examples. I like kathigu-ras design and would love to pull on her rerun, but if she can’t clear endgame content it feels like a waste of limited currency and/or real USD.

-certain play stiles that people enjoy (counter, poison) being in desperate need of a buff even before the changes.

Maybe you plan to fix some of these in the next update. If so, you should say something soon. You have already acknowledged that your communication has been lacking, you can show us that you are making an effort to do better now. You don’t have to know specifically what you are going to do right this second, you have two weeks-ish to plan, something general like “we are planning to buff units in the next patch” would be great. There is a middle ground between “rushed response within 24 hours” and “complete radio silence”
